basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old environmental science enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I've been vegetarian for over a decade and enjoy exploring sustainable living practices. I work as a research assistant at a local university, which keeps me busy. In my free time, I love attending music festivals, particularly if Two Door Cinema Club is playing, and I dabble in sim racing games. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Environmental Science and have worked in various research roles focusing on sustainable agriculture and food systems. Much of my knowledge comes from academic study as well as self-directed learning through online courses and community engagement.
